scope: 5 newly recognized Special Energy components and fully supported additional cards; no previous supported program or metadata changes.

sources.title: Aromatic Grass Energy
sources.checkedFacts: Grass host recovers from all conditions and cannot receive any; no Grass-only attachment restriction.

sources.title: Therapeutic Energy
sources.checkedFacts: Only Sleep, Confusion and Paralysis are cured/prevented; Poison and Burn remain.

sources.title: Spiral Energy
sources.checkedFacts: Rapid Strike-only attachment, immediate discard on invalid host, one selectable Energy unit, continuous Paralysis cure and immunity.

sources.title: Official FAQ: Impact Energy on an invalid host
sources.checkedFacts: An effect can attach Impact Energy to Hatterene V but it is immediately discarded and does not cure Poison. Test covers the same invalid-host boundary through the already supported discard-source override.

sources.title: Temple of Sinnoh official strategy
sources.checkedFacts: Special Energy override removes other effects; the cure resumes once the override leaves.

boundaries: Five complete Special Energy definitions; no older supported programs or metadata change.
Cure is continuous and independent of attachment source, Ability suppression and Tool suppression.
Only the explicitly listed Special Conditions are cured and prevented. Existing Poison/Burn survive Therapeutic Energy.
A typed host predicate reads all printed types, with legacy combat fallback only when tags are absent.
Cure occurs during attachment before later components of the same program, and before Pokemon Checkup.
Invalid style Energy cannot cure before it is discarded; removing suppression re-enables valid ongoing cures.
No artwork, client, installation or GameTest changes.
